name: Corsair
description: Connects your app and its agents to third-party services through one TypeScript SDK, with per-tenant OAuth and API keys, approval gates, verified webhooks and MCP tool adapters.

skills.name: MCP Tool Adapters
skills.description: Exposes every installed integration as MCP tools for the Anthropic SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, Mastra and coding agents.

skills.name: Approval Permissions
skills.description: Gates write and destructive agent actions behind human approval using open, cautious, strict or readonly policies, optionally hosted on Hub.

skills.name: Multi-Tenant Credentials
skills.description: Isolates OAuth tokens, API keys and integration data per tenant, with a connect flow that resumes failed work once a tenant links an account.

skills.name: Verified Webhooks
skills.description: Receives provider events on one signature-verified endpoint for every integration plugin, with handlers in your own application.
